name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.1: dashboard front page rebuilt for daily mobile use, completing the UI housekeeping across the three operator screens. Todays performance is now a hero card at the top (revenue, change vs yesterday, a 7-day micro-trend, items sold, machines online, open alerts) since that is checked repeatedly through the day. Below it, restock due lists the machines worth visiting (days since restock, sold-out slots, fill level, most urgent first) and needs attention lists open alerts. Revenue trends, machine performance and currently sold out are collapsed below. The machines overview table is removed, as the redesigned machine list page now owns that. Adds a vs-yesterday string in English and Icelandic. Cumulative over v6.0.7.
